description: This file contains unit tests for the LeaveCommentAPI class within the OrangeHRM HRM system, specifically testing functionalities such as creating comments, retrieving comments, and validation rules related to leave comments.

classes.name: LeaveCommentAPITest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class for testing the LeaveCommentAPI endpoints, including create, getAll, and delete actions. It verifies the behavior of the API methods, including exception handling and validation rules.

methods.name: testGetLeaveRequestCommentService
methods.description: Tests that the API correctly returns an instance of LeaveRequestCommentService.

methods.name: testCreate
methods.description: Tests creating a leave comment via the API, including successful creation and normalization of response data.

methods.name: testCreateLeaveRecordNotFound
methods.description: Tests behavior when the referenced leave record is not found during comment creation, expecting a not-found exception.

methods.name: testGetValidationRuleForCreate
methods.description: Validates that the validation rules for creating a leave comment accept correct input.

methods.name: testGetAll
methods.description: Tests retrieving all comments for a specific leave, verifying proper data normalization.

methods.name: testGetAllLeaveRecordNotFound
methods.description: Tests behavior when the leave record is not found during getAll request, expecting a not-found exception.

methods.name: testGetValidationRuleForGetAll
methods.description: Validates that the validation rules for getAll comments accept correct input.

methods.name: testDelete
methods.description: Ensures that the delete method is properly stubbed out as not implemented and throws the expected exception.

methods.name: testGetValidationRuleForDelete
methods.description: Ensures that the validation rule getter for delete throws a not implemented exception.
